paper.how_en: Keep it dry, flatten, stack and tie it.

paper_pack.how_en: Rinse, dry, and use the carton box, not the paper pile.

plastic.how_en: Empty, rinse, remove labels and other parts.

clear_pet.how_en: Empty, label off, crush, cap on. Separate from other plastic.

vinyl.how_en: Empty, rinse, put in a bag so it doesn't blow away.

clothes.how_en: Use the clothing collection box; keep it dry.

general.how_en: Put it in your district's paid garbage bag.

nonburnable.how_en: Special non-burnable sack per your district.

bulky.how_en: Report it to your district and attach the fee sticker.

ewaste.how_en: Electronics: e-waste collection (free pickup for many items).

dropoff.how_en: Take it to the dedicated collection box.

consult.how_en: Not regular household waste. Ask the seller or a specialist.

material.how_en: Sort by what it's made of.
